snippet.title: Sonic 2K6 2D - The Last/Lost Version
snippet.description:
I HOPE YOU LIKE WORDS, BECAUSE YOU NEED TO READ THIS FIRST:

In August 2006, I had a level design itch I wanted to scratch, so I remade a Sonic 2006 level in 2D. I occasionally revisited the project to tweak and add stuff. This lasted 3-5 months. In January of 2007, I lost the source code to the project in a HDD crash, right when I was getting close to release. In February of 2011, I finally recovered the unfinished beta. I spent a week fixing up the game to get it in to a functional state so I could release it. I am not entirely proud of what is here, nor is it as finished and as polished as I would have liked. There's a ton more information about the game in its readme.html file. I highly suggest you read it!

https://mega.co.nz/#!OB9FjKhR!U7V8n1AgNCXKdIgNYFlvWxxSKBMTSQdepnOBt1REO60 (33.6mb)
